def: a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar

occurrences.text: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
